text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It's sheer chaos...!
Like an orchestra without a conductor!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Is it the amount of Siberian ginseng extract after all...?
Or is there too much dried carrot extract...?!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Guaranteed to revitalize, its color is a tempest of beauty
that would make even the finest paintings weep!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: And yet, it must be the utmost delicacy...! A flavor so profound it inspires true craving!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Ah...! How foolish to imitate divine craftsmanship!
Is this a tower unable to reach the heavens?!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Nay... even if they mock it as taboo!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
To my sworn ally, weighed down by fatigue—
I shall surely brew you a supreme cup!
And so, completely absorbed in crafting mocktails, Tanino Gimlet ended up skipping her training.
